comment: T-3708. Tests whose failure is tolerated until a stated date. An entry needs a file, the test's FULL title (describe ancestry joined to the test title by ' › ', matching internal/e2egate's TitleSeparator and web/e2e/quarantine.json's own convention), a reason saying what is actually known about the flake, the ticket that will remove or re-triage the entry, and an expiry no more than 42 days out. On the day after `expires` the build fails whether or not the test did — an expiry nobody enforces is a disabled test wearing a deadline. internal/vitestgate's TestRepoQuarantineIsValid checks this file on every `make check`, so an entry that quietly expires reddens the tree without anyone re-running vitest. Empty is the healthy state; keeping it that way is the point.
